lines: Viper, this is quite a dramatic letter.

lines: Read the capitalized words as a mathematical expression.
Start with four thousand. Double it, divide by four, then subtract three.

radioMonologues.title: Hint 1
lines: Viper, those relay names aren't random.
Listen to the recording carefully. It's describing the order in which they activated.

radioMonologues.title: Hint 2
lines: Owl goes last. Moth comes immediately before Wolf. And Fox must come before Moth.
Once you have the order, replace each relay name with its symbol from the terminal.

puzzles.terminalText:
ENCRYPTION CONFIGURATION
PERSONAL SECURITY PATCH

I don't trust ordinary passwords.

That's why I moved every letter
THREE places FORWARD in the alphabet.

A becomes D.
B becomes E.
C becomes F.

ENCRYPTED KEY: FRPUDGH

DECRYPT TO CONTINUE.
puzzles.correctResponse:
ENCRYPTION BYPASSED.
FOURTH SECURITY LOCK DISABLED.
puzzles.wrongResponse:
DECRYPTION FAILED.
ENCRYPTED KEY NOT ACCEPTED.

radioMonologues.title: Hint 1
lines: A classic substitution cipher, Viper.
He changed the letters, but he was careless enough to leave the method behind.

radioMonologues.title: Hint 2
lines: The encrypted letters were shifted three places forward.
Move each letter in FRPUDGH three places backward to recover the password.

puzzles.terminalText:

FOUR KEYS ACCEPTED.

THE ARCHIVE NEVER FORGETS.

radioMonologues.title: Hint 1
lines: You're almost there, Viper.
You've already entered four successful passwords. A computer like this must keep records of them somewhere.

radioMonologues.title: Hint 2
lines: Use DIR to find the access log. Then open it with READ ACCESS.LOG.
Take the last character of each accepted password, in the order you entered them.

introduction.title: Introduction
lines: Viper, do you copy? Colonel Krivorotov here.
Congratulations! You've made it to Fantomantis's personal computer.
I could tell you exactly what to do next, but where's the fun in that?
I'll leave the interesting part to you.
If you run into trouble, tune back to this frequency. I'll give you a hint.
Good luck, Viper. Krivorotov out.

finalText:
Top secret data:

I LIKE YOU, VIPER.

You're so cute.
And so naive.

Did you really think
a top-secret computer
would be covered
in password clues?

Who do you think
left them there?

Yours,
Fantomantis

monologues.title: Relay Test Recording
lines: Relay test recording. The activation log has been lost.
Four relays were tested. Here's what I remember.
I remember Owl was the last to activate.
Moth activated immediately before Wolf.
And Fox was already active when Moth came online.
That's all I've got. End of recording.
